outcome: Neonatal outcomes (umbilical cord blood pH, Apgar scores)
cohort: 69 patients with placenta previa major and/or accretism
finding: Predelivery uterine artery embolization was found to be a safe and effective procedure for managing placenta previa major and/or accretism, with preserved myometrial perfusion and no areas of necrosis observed in follow-up MRI.
